p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4ce394ec.py')

s='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (6,)), None)
    if marker is None:
        return out
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                if row[c] == 6:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
